title: 点阵图分歧大：美联储决议后，科技还能追吗
speaker: E. Catarina Bego

segments.en: I would say it's a certainty. I think the indications were not secure in terms of whether the trajectory is going to be, and I think you can see how the worst didn't contribute to the dot plot.
segments.zh: 我会说这是一种确定性。此前的信号并不足以确认路径走向，而点阵图里也能看出一些分歧。

segments.en: And I think to say that certainty, it's, it's not the case, but what the market has done is digested the Fed decision and look through that and is looking at more, where the intersecting stories are.
segments.zh: 说完全确定其实也不尽然，但市场已经消化了美联储的决定，并越过这一事件，去寻找更交叉的主线。

segments.en: So we've seen some pullback obviously in the overall rates, and we've seen a little bit of a pullback in kind of the spreads, and obviously the equity market has rallied more broadly.
segments.zh: 我们看到整体利率有所回落，利差也略有收窄，权益市场则出现了更广泛的回暖。

segments.en: So it's important if you look at actually parts of the market, place like tech actually is rallied by high magnitude, because again, the investors are looking at where is the structural opportunity.
segments.zh: 所以重要的是看市场的结构，科技板块涨幅尤其明显，因为大家在寻找结构性机会在哪里。

segments.en: And they still valid, do I chase that and do I deploy that into second kind of the lot part of the year?
segments.zh: 这些机会仍然有效，问题是要不要追、要不要在下半年继续布局。
